title: Smart Organizer and remote ecosystem
objective: Add deterministic-first file organization, constrained local AI fallback and optional phone/CEC control.
acceptance: Smart Organizer classifies common files and ROMs without an LLM when deterministic evidence is sufficient.
llama.cpp loads only on demand, returns constrained structured plans and has no shell access.
File mutations are restricted to allowed directories and support preview/undo.
Phone remote and/or CEC map into the same InputAction contract used by HID input.

history.reason: Roadmap outcome defined; acceptance may be amended before LOCKED.
